description:
Apple backend declares NetworkIsolation: false (apple.go line 436). This means agents have unrestricted internet access, breaking the security model.

Options to investigate:
- Apple Container CLI network mode flags (--network=none, --network=host)
- In-VM nftables rules (like nspawn backend uses)
- Virtualization.framework network configuration API
- Allowlist-based filtering for restricted mode

Needed for template options: network: none, network: restricted, allowedHosts list.
title: Apple runtime: network isolation support
